title: Benchmarks card: match Hard-Decisions headline figures
description: Benchmarks page summarizes Hard-Decisions as 'Jev still answers 89.3% correctly at that depth' while hard-decisions.anth.us leads with 'Jev leads the open-world task at 83.8%, ahead of GLiDE at 82.9%' across 9 models. Both may be true (depth-5 vs overall) but a reader comparing the two pages sees different headline numbers. Align the benchmarks card with the live site's headline figure and model count, and re-check whenever the leaderboard reruns.
